title: County message runner card
body: Delivery: office to road crews. Return copy expected when access resumes. Reverse: “Please bring the chipped blue cup back; it was my sister's.”
rival_reading: A farm program could use an office runner for field notices; a return copy and family note do not show that containment failed.
gloss: A runner's card keeps a personal request beside an official route.

title: The clipboard held the only spare
body: A keyring is fastened beneath the clipboard clip. Its tag is worn smooth; the page above it has two pencil holes and no writing.
rival_reading: A field courier could secure a site key to a blank clipboard before a handoff; the empty page does not prove anyone was left without instructions.
gloss: An access key is attached to a page that was never filled in.
